sourceRevision.workingTreeReview: 2026-09-08: three app integration fixtures updated to exact/paged lookup, valid card rows, deliberate legacy ingress rejection, canonical LF keys and safe reserved-confirmation retry. Existing dependency roots retained; evidence line references remapped to the reviewed test source. 2026-09-11: bind the fully reviewed BuildVersion/Timestamped and dependency-free canister_state_macros/git_commit_id support sources. 2026-09-14: trace the release-tool expected-Wasm-SHA256 guard's three external edges, bind its actual fixed shell invocation and declare isolated Windows/Linux host metadata profiles. These are build/tool contexts, not deployed canister roots or whole-upgrader review. Remaining nested-state, test-fixture and native gaps are not cleared. 2026-09-14: bind the local arm64 all-WebGPU profile without inference, store or devtools. Rebind 13 inherited native model/IPC/build roots to current PR2 source and lock identities, alongside four existing mobile app/cache-policy roots. Identical model sources retain their prior source review; the plugin manifest adds only the separately scoped desktop open dependency and commands.rs only reorders the unchanged capability probe. This is a local APK composition, not the full inherited model/native union for other profiles. 2026-09-14: add the caller-side group-index upload schema used by shared feature-test setup as two normal/test roots, Windows-default only. Pin the helper, API schemas and bounded primitive aliases; unrelated implementation and API siblings remain excluded. 2026-09-14: close the caller-side shared setup/upload/subnet/registration schema review. Add user-index registration lookup Candid/Serde/ts-rs as three normal/test roots (Windows-default only), including its previously omitted generated ts-rs owner edge. Pin the remaining helper/response schemas; sixteen supporting files are source-equivalent across slices and the registration helper was checked at its slice-specific location. Unrelated fixture implementation side effects remain explicitly outside this root boundary. 2026-09-14: bind five previously unpinned user-index app-token/throttle schema sources and the app-only fields in group/community/group-index/local-user-index Data. Reviewed schema/default paths reuse existing production Candid/Serde/serde_bytes and hash-owner roots except two missing generated group/community Data-to-Serde owner edges caught by the new regression. Add those two normal/production roots for wasm-default and windows-default only; the already-selected Serde package and all native/mobile profiles are unchanged. A pinned direct-ts_export-consumer regression rejects missing generated ts-rs owner edges. This bounded state-schema pass does not claim complete call-graph coverage or change the incomplete inventory API.

unresolved.description: Reviewed UserId/OCError, timestamp/payload serialization, stable-memory, clock and explicit macro/runtime edges remain mapped. The bounded pass found no extra edge in BuildVersion/Timestamped, the selected action-card wrappers, dependency-free canister_state_macros or git_commit_id; this is not a complete pass over all reachable nested types/generated owner calls.

Opts::parse reads the new expected_wasm_sha256 String argument before loading identity or Wasm; the shell forwards the caller's trusted digest. Only the changed guard/argument is covered, not the entire tool's existing canister-client options or transport.

The new verify_wasm_sha256 guard calls the existing sha256 wrapper, which uses sha2. This edge is separate from app-envelope production and fixture test uses. ASCII digest parsing and byte comparison use std, not an invented hex dependency.

The guard loads local Wasm through get_canister_wasm -> file_by_prefix -> sorted_unstable_by_key. This selects itertools only; it does not select canister_agent_utils' unchanged ic-agent/ic-utils network or identity helpers.

App-card fan-out setup registers diamond users. Its host-side upgrade_user calls ledger::happy_path::transfer with UserId, which invokes types::UserId's From implementation for the external ICRC Account. This is a test-only conversion actually reached by the feature fixture, not a seed inferred from mixed-file imports or an inventory of ledger/canister implementations. PR1 model_catalog's ordinary register_user does not take this upgrade path.
